editions.title: Cyber — Saturday, 31 October 2026
editions.lead: Binance says about $6.3 billion was drained from its wallets on 29 Oct, and two blockchain firms, TRM and Chainalysis, tie the theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor; Binance has not confirmed that attribution.

editions.title: Chile — Saturday, 31 October 2026
editions.lead: Kast accepted the resignation of Justice Undersecretary Luis Silva over the sentence-cut decrees and named Josefina Soto to replace him, while prosecutors opened a probe into Justice Minister Fernando Rabat and the opposition readies a constitutional accusation for Tuesday 3 November.

editions.title: AI daily — 31 October 2026
editions.lead: Wiz's 30 October report ties at least nine AI developer platform breaches in October to stolen model keys, with two stolen enterprise keys used for about 2.5 million model calls.

editions.title: Chile — Friday, 30 October 2026
editions.lead: The opposition is set to file a constitutional accusation against Justice Minister Fernando Rabat, reportedly on Tuesday 3 November, while Kast keeps him in office.

editions.title: Cyber — Friday, 30 October 2026
editions.lead: Binance says a security incident has an estimated impact of about $6.3 billion, with roughly $3 billion frozen so far, and its initial investigation suggests a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop may be involved.
